hook_patterns.name: 충격 수치
examples: 99% of people use ChatGPT wrong.
Only 3% of people know this free AI tool.
87% of your monthly subscriptions are wasted.

hook_patterns.name: 금지/경고
examples: Stop paying for apps you don't need.
Stop saving money in a savings account.
Stop using Google Search for everything.

hook_patterns.name: 반전
examples: Everyone says you need 8 hours of sleep. They're wrong.
Everyone says AI will take your job. Here's the truth.
Everyone thinks saving money makes you rich. It doesn't.

hook_patterns.name: 도발
examples: Delete your ChatGPT subscription right now.
Delete all your productivity apps. You only need this one.
Cancel your gym membership. This works better.

hook_patterns.name: 가정/질문
examples: What if I told you your brain lies to you every day?
What if I told you you're already using AI wrong?
What if I told you you could retire 10 years earlier?

hook_patterns.name: 비밀
examples: Nobody talks about this free AI tool.
Nobody tells you this about compound interest.
NASA never showed you this sound from space.

hook_patterns.name: 비용 공개
examples: You're wasting $200 every month on apps.
You're losing $500 a year on subscriptions you forgot about.
This free tool does what you pay $50/month for.

hook_patterns.name: 시간 압박
examples: In 30 seconds, I'll change how you use AI forever.
In the next 20 seconds, you'll learn a $10,000 lesson.
In 15 seconds, I'll show you something NASA hid for decades.

cta_patterns: Save this for later. Follow for more.
Share this with someone who needs it.
If this blew your mind, follow for daily {niche_topic}.
